)
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _load_done_ids(path: str) -> set:
    """Extract completed sample IDs from result file (JSON array or JSONL).
    Only IDs are kept in memory — full records are discarded."""
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():

    with open(p) as f:
        first_char = f.read(1)
        if not first_char:
            return done
        f.seek(0)
        if first_char == '[':
            for rec in json.load(f):
                if "id" in rec:
                    done.add(rec["id"])
        else:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    rec = json.loads(line)
                    if "id" in rec:
                        done.add(rec["id"])
    return done

    """Convert JSON array file to JSONL format for append-only writes."""
    with open(json_path) as f:
        records = json.load(f)
    with open(jsonl_path, 'w') as out:
        for rec in records:
            out.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    del records
    gc.collect()
